title: LowDurabilityWarning
description: Never break your tools by accident again — get an on-screen warning and sound alert when durability gets low.
body:
Low Durability Warning helps you notice when the item in your hand is getting close to breaking.

When your tool, weapon, or any damageable item reaches low durability, the mod shows a clear on-screen warning and plays an alert sound. If you keep holding the same low-durability item, it will remind you every few seconds, giving you time to stop, switch items, or repair it before it breaks.

It is simple, lightweight, and works quietly in the background. Whether you are mining, fighting, building, or exploring, this mod helps protect your important gear from breaking when you are not paying attention.

Client-side only. No server installation required.
